caption: The drawing features two rectangular panels side by side, each with a distinct floral cutout design framed by a textured, woodgrain-like border. Both panels are composed in black and white. The panel on the left contains symmetrical, stylized floral motifs with curved petal-like shapes, large rounded leaves, and upward-growing stems, all emanating from a central vertical axis. The panel on the right has a similar bordered frame but with slanted corners, containing a more complex arrangement with three large circular, radial-flower shapes positioned in a triangular formation, interconnected by symmetrical, thick stems and flanked by S-shaped leaves. Both designs have a high degree of symmetry and are checkered with negative (white) floral shapes against a darker, closely-lined background mimicking wood texture, all contained within clearly defined rectangular borders on a plain, light background.
title: Panels from Hartford Chest
